An ideal vacation home, Nolan's Nook offers the finest furnishings designed for those with discerning tastes. . The home was designed with upscale amenities not typically present in a beach home, or for that matter, in most residential homes. This is a town home with out the inconveniences of having neighbors. All walls are solid and all doors are heavy and solid, zero noise travels through.

Two gourmet kitchens, granite countertops, pine floors, a residential elevator, private pool, spa, jetted tub, wainscoting, all cotton linens and down pillows/comforters serve as the foundation for your comfort.

Enjoy amazing Gulf views and sounds. Experience spectacular sunsets from over 1000 square feet of furnished balcony space.

Ceiling fans, hi-definition LCD TVs, Blu-ray DVD players and Internet "APP/widget" support enhance bedroom and living areas. Complementary broadband wireless Internet access serves your needs. A residential elevator provides comfortable access and help in stocking home with kitchen groceries or ease of access for elderly family members. Full laundry facilities are available.

In the morning, at lunch, or after an exhausting day of fun, enjoy the warmth of your family and friends in the comfort of a large upper level living area that includes a gourmet kitchen with the finest appliances, refrigerator/freezer, dishwasher, ice maker and microwave. Enjoy meals together on a large designer kitchen table that can easily service a very large family.

The adjacent living area opens to a large Pottery Barn furnished balcony that faces spectacular Gulf views.

The upper level offers a master king (sleeps 2) bedroom, with a private bath that has separate bath and spacious walk in shower. Use of the private serene furnished balcony is a great place to read or enjoy an early morning coffee.

A half bathroom is centrally located on the upper level.

On the second level are two master bedroom suites: one king (sleeps 2) and the other with 2 full beds (sleeps 4). Each have private separate shower/tubs (the king master tub is jetted), walk-in closets and furnished balconies with great views. A bunk room with 2 full size twin beds (sleeps 2) with a private full bathroom located here. Full laundry facilities with a washer and dryer are centrally located on the second level.

The ground level has a cabana living space that includes a full kitchen, range, refrigerator, microwave, ice maker, queen Murphy bed (sleeps 2), a queen sleeper (sleeps 2) and full bathroom.
Exit the back of the home where a beautifully landscaped courtyard with its small private pool, spa, patio, cantilever umbrellas and a gas grill that awaits you for family lounging or evening cook-outs.

Just 100 yards from Nolan's Nook front door is a level access to one of the most beautiful beaches in America(no steps to climb). This is on the south side of Hwy 30-A which means no roads to cross to the beach. This is especially great for the safety of children.

Inlet Beach is a gorgeous, uncongested "sugar sand" beach that adjoins the east side of Rosemary Beach and the west end of Camp Helen State Park and salt water Lake Powell at the east end of Scenic 30A. Sunning, swimming, fishing, and kayaking are available.

For those that want to get up and out there is a short bike ride or one-mile walk to Rosemary Beach shops and restaurants. A newly built outdoor shopping mall, called Pier Park is a short 10-minute drive east on 98 (toward Panama City) that has a large cinema, shops, restaurants, and an amusement park. Nearby golf courses include Camp Creek Golf Club, Shark's Tooth, Bay Pointe, Santa Rosa Beach Golf Club, The Hombre, and Burnt Pine. This area is a hidden paradise for golfers.

We are confident that you will enjoy your stay at Nolan's Nook. We are thrilled to share our home with you and hope that you will create lifetime memories and unwind from the stresses of everyday life.

This home does sleep up to 16 but an additional guest fee of $700 will be charged over 12 guests or over the contracted amount of people.

For larger groups consider our sister properties nearby (Marimac's Maison and Wally's World) see VRBO listing #s 356000 and 355212.

Keywords: Nolan's Nook is a new luxurious 3500 square foot home. This beautiful, 6 bedroom 6 bathroom home is located within the Enclave at Inlet Beach (tucked between Rosemary Beach and Camp Helen State Park) a small, quiet, safe, and upscale gated community. Great Residential Elevator.
Tucked away in the eastern-most point of Scenic Highway 30-A in South Walton, Inlet Beach will have you immersed in the coastal lifestyle in no time. This convenient location allows easy access to the infamous Rosemary Beach, yet is just a few minutes to vast shopping opportunities of Panama City Beach. With its laid-back residential feel and eclectic mix of classic Florida beach cottages and new multi-level homes, this peaceful paradise strikes a perfect balance of classic and modern. This sleepy little beach town got its name back in the early 1920's when the McCaskill Investment Company of DeFuniak Springs introduced it to the buying public. When young World War II veterans returned to the area and applied for land through a latter-day version of the Homestead Act, the town really started hopping. In fact, so many veterans built in the area at that time it was often referred to as "Soldiers Beach."
